content:
Although there are still eight hours until the Made by Google 2026 event officially begins, Google has already fully revealed the details of the Pixel 11, Pixel Watch 5, and Pixel Tag.

Below is a summary of everything announced at Made by Google 2026. Each section includes a link to our full hands-on reviews of the hardware and software features, with more articles to come in the next few hours.

Table of Contents

Pixel 11

The Pixel 11 features an all-glass camera bar that is 40% thinner than the previous generation, with a noticeably reduced protrusion. Google claims that once fitted with the official case, this "platform" virtually "disappears".

It uses a larger 48-megapixel wide-angle sensor, with 56% improved light sensitivity and a slightly wider field of view. The Tensor G6 processor paired with a 5x telephoto lens enables 30x Super Res Zoom.

The processor comes with 12GB of RAM and 256GB of storage as the new standard configuration. This year's base model supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging (up from last year's 15W), a 25% increase in speed, while the officially claimed 30+ hour battery life remains unchanged.

The Pixel 11 comes in four colours: Frost, Obsidian, Hibiscus, and Pistachio, starting at US$899.

Hands-on review | Pre-order: Google Store — Amazon — Best Buy

Pixel 11 Pro and 11 Pro XL

The Pro series' bezel-less camera bar features a design Google calls "HiLight". After three generations, what replaces the temperature sensor is a ring of ambient LED lights built around the flash. Its purpose is to keep you connected when the Pixel 11 Pro's screen is face down. For example, when Gemini is listening to you, it uses different patterns to provide visual feedback, representing listening, thinking, and responding, similar to Google Home speakers. You can also set custom colours to flash when favourite contacts call (supporting Phone by Google and WhatsApp), with future updates adding more features such as message notifications. You can enable HiLight and set one of five colours from the contact's Google Contacts page.

  • The Pixel 11 Pro is powered by Google's most powerful Gemini Intelligence, starting at US$1,099 [Hands-on review]
  • HiLight on the Pixel 11 Pro only has two functions at launch, with more features coming soon

The Pixel 11 Pro and 11 Pro XL feature a new 50-megapixel wide-angle sensor, along with a 48-megapixel telephoto lens with a larger image sensor, offering 30% improved light sensitivity. These upgrades enable 5x portrait mode, as well as 120x Pro Zoom powered by the Tensor G6 and Google's latest imaging model. The processor and redesigned software also bring faster Instant Night Sight, up to 4.5 times quicker.

The Super Actua display's peak brightness has been increased to 3,600 nits, paired with a new coating that doubles scratch resistance.

The Tensor G6 on the 256GB model comes with 12GB of RAM. Regarding the 4GB RAM reduction, Google credits software and chip optimisations, claiming smoother and faster performance than last year's Pro models. That said, you can opt for the 512GB or 1TB model to upgrade to 16GB of RAM.

For the 11 Pro XL, faster wired charging can reach 75% in approximately 30 minutes, while 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging speed has also increased by 29%.

This year's phones come in Canyon, Fog, Olive, and for the first time, an all-matte Obsidian, with design inspiration drawn from nature. The 6.3-inch Pixel 11 Pro starts at US$1,099, and the 6.8-inch Pixel 11 Pro XL starts at US$1,299. As for the Pro models, Google now only offers a six-month AI Pro subscription.

Hands-on review | Pre-order:

Amazon: Pixel 11 Pro | 11 Pro XL

Pixel 11 Pro Fold

The Pixel 11 Pro Fold is nearly 10% lighter than last year's model (258g vs 239g) and 0.7mm thinner. This foldable features a new glass-fibre composite back panel that is three times more durable, making it "virtually shatter-proof". The new hinge design protects the inner screen from accidental drop damage.

The 6.5-inch outer screen has been upgraded to Super Actua (20% brighter) and is protected by glass ceramic. The inner Super Actua Flex display (peak brightness 3,600 nits) has slimmer bezels, thicker ultra-thin glass, and two layers of impact-resistant film for improved crease performance.

The new 48-megapixel wide-angle sensor improves light sensitivity by 56%, while the telephoto lens supports 30x Super Zoom. The Pixel 11 Pro Fold also features HiLight.

The Tensor G6 comes with 16GB of RAM and 256GB of storage. Battery capacity has decreased from 5,015mAh to 4,750mAh, but the 24+ hour battery life rating is maintained, along with 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging support.

Gboard's instant transcription feature supports American Sign Language (ASL). The Sign-to-Text feature allows you to "sign towards the front-facing camera, with viewers seeing transcribed text on the outer screen". Combined with Android 17's Bubble Bar displayed in the bottom-right corner, and two new Made You Look animations in the camera app.

The Pixel 11 Pro Fold has increased in price by US$100 to US$1,899, though it comes with 16GB of RAM and 256GB of storage.

Tensor G6

The new Gemini Nano 4 model with TPU delivers 50% more computing power and double the memory bandwidth. These improvements enable up to 3.5 times faster on-device AI tasks while reducing power consumption by up to 3.5 times.

Meanwhile, the CPU enables 15% faster app loading and 25% faster web browsing.

The upgraded ISP (Image Signal Processor) unlocks more camera features, including a wider zoom range and improved low-light performance. A new custom accelerator is designed specifically for capturing and rendering 4K Bokeh portrait video.

Featuring the new Titan M3 security chip, which helps defend against future quantum computing threats.

New Pixel camera and video features

Although the overall camera app looks largely unchanged, Google has made numerous adjustments to accommodate new features. For example, quick controls now include sliders for Looks, focus, shutter speed, and ISO, in addition to white balance, exposure, and shadows. The new interface allows you to select apps that launch after long-pressing either side of the viewfinder.

  • Pixel 11 camera features new main sensor, "Camera Looks", "Instant Night Sight" and more
  • Pixel 11 video recording capabilities enhanced with Pro Stable Video, Creator Suite and more

Magic Capture is similar to Google Clips—you simply start a capture session, and Google will automatically select the best HDR+ photos and videos. It can be accessed from a new tab next to the photo and video modes, analysing approximately 500 frames to find the best one, with options to crop, straighten, Unblur, and other light edits. The goal is to let you simply point at the scene and stay in the moment.

Camera Looks allows you to set preset aesthetic styles while shooting. Google has adjusted the camera's image processing pipeline, such as "merging fewer frames than usual to create a minimally post-processed feel" and "rewriting colour lookup tables at the sensor level to simulate traditional film chemistry". The Pixel 11 offers these HDR alternative options:

  • Natural: Softer detail rendering
  • Shadows: Deeper contrast
  • Vanilla: Warmer and softer tones with golden hues

There are also Stylistic Looks coming later, including Digi, Black Tie, Minimal, Editorial, Classic, and Velvet, which users can further edit.

On-device video processing features improved sharpening, noise reduction, and detail handling, while the Pro model's Pro Stable Video activates in shaky, well-lit scenes. The new Creator Suite adds multiple tools to the camera app:

  • Teleprompter: Follows your speaking rhythm automatically, adjusting speed and pauses to match your pace.
  • Project Folders: Store videos in designated locations.
  • Audio Visualizer: For microphone checks within the camera viewfinder.
  • Storyboard: Edit and rearrange videos via Google Photos.
  • Social Media Grid Lines

Gemini Intelligence

Task automation features on the Pixel 11 series have expanded to more apps, helping you handle orders and reservations. Gemini can also call merchants to complete tasks.

Gboard Rambler goes beyond voice-to-text, filtering out lengthy sentences and filler words such as "um" or "ah". Once activated, Rambler takes over Gboard's suggestion bar, displaying a new waveform animation. It captures your semantics, generating clean and concise voice transcriptions.

Proactive Assistance (formerly Magic Cue) provides contextual suggestions and now applies to more scenarios with a richer interface. When you tap these suggestions, a new bottom panel pops up. You can see detailed flight information with live status links, Google Maps data, calendar previews for appointments, tasks (such as booking a table), and comparison information. Gemini Intelligence can also suggest saving events to your calendar and storing other information in Google Wallet.

Google previewed a new At a Glance feature that can display membership cards when you're in a store, or Google Maps information when you're at a restaurant, based on your location.

The call translation feature launched last year now extends to podcasts and videos on YouTube and other supported apps, providing real-time audio dubbing via the Tensor G6.

New Pixelsnap accessories

The latest Pixelsnap cases come in colours that complement the phones, with new transparent cases available this year. The Pixelsnap Ring Stand now comes in three colours: Canyon, Olive, and Obsidian.

Hands-on review | Pre-order: Google Store — Amazon

Pixel Tag

The Google Pixel Tag is a Find Hub location tracker priced at US$29 (or US$99 for a four-pack). It has a pill shape with a "G" logo on the back and a removable coin-cell battery. This accessory won't be available until November 11.

Pixel Buds Pro 2 updates

The Pixel Buds Pro 2 will be available in a new Olive colour. More importantly, both the Pixel Buds Pro 2 and Pixel Buds 2a will receive a major software update in September. The new Pro 2 firmware will improve noise cancellation based on how the earbuds fit in your ear canal. Google will "make adjustments to compensate for slight changes in the fit seal".

Meanwhile, both the Pixel Buds Pro 2 and Pixel Buds 2a will gain Gemini audio control features, allowing voice commands such as "Hey Google, increase the bass" to adjust settings.

Pixel Watch's sleep sync feature will detect when you've fallen asleep and pause music, disable touch controls, and silence notifications. The upgraded instant translation feature can be activated to "trigger listening mode, understanding over 70 languages nearly instantly".

Pixel Watch 5

The Pixel Watch 5 has the same exterior design as its predecessor. Internally, it's upgraded to the Snapdragon W5 Gen 2 Accelerated, with 12% improved CPU performance and RAM increased from 2GB to 3GB. Combined with the M55 co-processor, device operation is 20% faster. Google has also doubled the storage to 64GB.

The Pixel Watch 5 offers twice the route tracking and location accuracy in urban areas, hiking trails, and other complex environments. Google claims it outperforms the Apple Watch Ultra 3 and Garmin Fenix 8 Pro.

  • The Pixel Watch 5 doesn't look much different on the surface, but you need to check "At a Glance" to see the difference [Hands-on review]
  • Pixel Watch 5 launches its own "Stephen Curry Edition" with exclusive band and watch face [Photo gallery]
  • Pixel Watch 5 features "second-generation Active Band"—here's what's changed and why it's worth your attention

This year's health feature upgrades include improved strength training and HIIT workout experiences, new Bedtime Automations, the addition of Breathing Emergency Detection, and support for blood pressure and insulin resistance trend tracking.

From Mckillio's top comment

Better than expected, especially in terms of camera (except for the front-facing camera), but still not enough to entice me to upgrade, especially having to upgrade to 512GB to get 16GB of RAM when I can't even fill up 256GB. Unless there are excellent reviews, I'll continue waiting for the 12P.

Two new watch faces have been added this year—Weave and Chronograph—along with new complication styles. There are also generative AI watch faces, somewhat similar to AI wallpapers on phones.

Gemini Intelligence brings At a Glance to the bottom of the watch face, displaying flight information, boarding passes, and transit stops. Proactive Suggestions can appear as one-tap actions in apps like Google Messages. Offline Gemini commands are supported for controlling timers, alarms, and starting workouts.

The Pixel Watch 5 41mm starts at US$399 (up US$50), the 45mm is priced at US$429 (up US$30), and the eSIM version is an additional US$100.
